```{r}
#| label: setup

library(targets)
source("packages.R") |>
  suppressMessages() |>
  suppressWarnings()
list.files(
  path       = "R",
  pattern    = "\\.R$",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  grep(x       = _,
       pattern = "^R\\/_",
       value   = TRUE,
       invert  = TRUE) |>
  sapply(FUN = source) |>
  invisible()
tar_load(de_id)
tar_load(df_pid)
tar_load(spo_pat_raw)
# tar_load(spo_pat_ref)
# tar_load(lst_chk)
# tar_load(lst_meta)
# tar_load(lst_out.ref)
tar_load(vct_raw)
tar_load(vct_basic)
tar_load(vct_nw.sleep)
tar_load(vct_out.cut)
tar_load(vct_cal)
tar_load(vct_out.raw)
tar_load(vct_out.oak.pre)
tar_load(vct_ox)
# tar_load(vct_ox_step)
# tar_load(vct_ox_wlms)
# tar_load(vct_ox_acti)
tar_load(vct_merge)

len_raw <- length(vct_raw)
df_out <- summarize_accelerometer_steps(
  de_id,
  df_pid,
  spo_pat_raw,
  vct_raw,
  vct_basic,
  vct_nw.sleep,
  vct_cal,
  vct_out.raw,
  vct_out.oak.pre,
  vct_out.cut,
  # vct_ox_step,
  # vct_ox_wlms,
  # vct_ox_acti
  vct_ox
)
lgl_all <- 
  df_out |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(
    all = all(c_across(
      !id
    ))
  ) |> 
  pull(all)
chk_do <- any(
  stri_detect(vct_merge,
              regex = "ANCHOR_DO")
)
chk_raw <- any(
  stri_detect(vct_merge,
              regex = "ANCHOR_RAW")
)

```

# Accelerometer Major Steps

Out of `r len_raw` raw accelerometer files, `r sum(lgl_all)` successfully went through the pipeline.

Below is a table listing if each major step was successful for a file (TRUE) or unsuccessful (FALSE)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-major

lst_green <- 
  list(
    cells_body(columns = GGIR,          rows = GGIR),
    cells_body(columns = nw.sleep,      rows = nw.sleep),
    cells_body(columns = calibration,   rows = calibration),
    cells_body(columns = `raw methods`, rows = `raw methods`),
    cells_body(columns = oak.pre,       rows = oak.pre),
    cells_body(columns = cutpoints,     rows = cutpoints),
    cells_body(columns = oxwearables,   rows = oxwearables)
    # cells_body(columns = stepcount,     rows = stepcount),
    # cells_body(columns = walmsley,      rows = walmsley),
    # cells_body(columns = actinet,       rows = actinet)
  ) |> 
  Filter(x = _,
         f = Negate(is.null))
lst_red <- 
  list(
    cells_body(columns = GGIR,          rows = !GGIR),
    cells_body(columns = nw.sleep,      rows = !nw.sleep),
    cells_body(columns = calibration,   rows = !calibration),
    cells_body(columns = `raw methods`, rows = !`raw methods`),
    cells_body(columns = oak.pre,       rows = !oak.pre),
    cells_body(columns = cutpoints,     rows = !cutpoints),
    cells_body(columns = oxwearables,   rows = !oxwearables)
    # cells_body(columns = stepcount,     rows = !stepcount),
    # cells_body(columns = walmsley,      rows = !walmsley),
    # cells_body(columns = actinet,       rows = !actinet)
  ) |> 
  Filter(x = _,
         f = Negate(is.null))
gt(df_out) |> 
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_fill(color = "#D9F1D5"),
    locations = lst_green
  ) |> 
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_fill(color = "#ea9999"),
    locations = lst_red
  )

```

# Direct Observation Summary

```{r}
#| label: do_text
#| output: asis

if (chk_do) {
cat("The following tables show, within each observation session:\n
- The total number of minutes captured by each method that measured physical activity intensity (i.e. the number of minutes where there is available data).\n
- The total number of minutes captured by each method that measured steps.\n
- The total number of moderate-to-vigorous minutes estimated by each method.\n
- The total number of sedentary minutes estimated by each method.\n
- The total number of steps estimated by each method.\n")
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo direct observation data supplied.\n\n")
}
```


```{r}
#| label: do_summary
#| eval: !expr chk_do
#| output: asis

lst_summary <- summarize_metrics_main(
    vct_anchor = stri_subset(vct_merge,
                             regex = "ANCHOR_DO")
  )

cat("## Available Data: Intensity (minutes)\n\n")

lst_summary$total_session_int3

cat("## Available Data: Steps (minutes)\n\n")

lst_summary$total_session_step

cat("## MVPA (minutes)\n\n")

lst_summary$total_mvpa

cat("## Sedentary (minutes)\n\n")

lst_summary$total_sed

cat("## Steps\n\n")

lst_summary$total_step

```

# Free-living Data Summary

```{r}
#| label: raw_text
#| output: asis

if (chk_raw) {
cat("The following tables show, within each free-living session, by date:\n
- The total number of hours captured by each method that measured physical activity intensity (i.e. the number of minutes where there is available data).\n
- The total number of hours captured by each method that measured steps.\n
- The total number of moderate-to-vigorous hours estimated by each method.\n
- The total number of sedentary hours estimated by each method.\n
- The total number of steps estimated by each method.\n")
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo free-living data supplied.\n\n")
}
```


```{r}
#| label: raw_summary

lst_summary$total_mvpa

cat("## Sedentary (hours)\n\n")

lst_summary$total_sed

cat("## Steps\n\n")

lst_summary$total_step
```

# tar_meta

```{r}
#| label: tar_meta

tar_meta(targets_only = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::filter(type != "branch") |> 
  select(name, warnings, error) |> 
  mutate(
    warnings = gsub(
      x = warnings,
      pattern = "\\w{0,1}package '.*' was built under R version 4.5.2.",
      replacement = ""
    )
  ) |> 
  kable()

```
